title: Fluffy Corn Biryani
description: A simple and flavorful Indian-inspired dish made with fluffy basmati rice, juicy corn, and aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: Jubilant Jubilee Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: custom blend with cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the Indian Biryani Masala and Jubilant Jubilee Spice Blend. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the fluffy basmati rice and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the corn and salt. Stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes or until the water is absorbed.
Fluff the biryani with a fork and garnish with chopped cilantro.
